summary: BranchOut Food Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 820,588 common shares at $3.40 per share, with a 30-day over-allotment option for 123,088 additional shares. The offering closed August 28, 2026, generating approximately $2.5 million net proceeds after a 7.0% underwriting discount. Lake Street Capital Markets acted as representative. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes. Officers and directors agreed to a 90-day lock-up. This is a routine capital raise under an existing S-3 shelf, not a special situation.
